title: CYP Induction Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required protocol parameters in the fields provided above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the custom labware files (with .json extensions) to upload.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol script file (with .py extension) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Set up the robot deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App; consult the support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to start the protocol.
